segments.en: Universal Century 0093...

It's the region where Neo Zeon and
the Earth Federation are at odds.

Right now, we can form an alliance
with either Londo Bell or the
Neo Zeon Army.

Londo Bell's base is
Londenion.

The Neo Zeon Army should be
at Sweetwater.

So, think about which one
we go with, Big Bro!

Wait, so I'm the one
who decides after all?

That's right. Either one
is fine with me.
Oh, okay...

rows.notes: Seg 7 header is Nelfea (not Rie, who asked the question); kept as Nelfea's line, wording works for either.

segments.en: Situation: Universal Century 0093

At present, we are allied
with the Earth Federation.

The Federation government has given
us Konpei Island as our army's base.

We must fight to repay
that debt.

We will eliminate those who defy
the Earth Federation government
and bring order to space.

There are two enemy forces
to be targeted.

One is the Neo Zeon Army, which
declared independence at Sweetwater.

The other is Londo Bell, who
were supposed to be our allies.
Why Londo Bell?

Not only are they keeping watch
on our movements,

they're also trying to make contact
with the Claudian Unified Forces.
We can't leave them be.

Our operations will not stop
at this universe.

To keep from being struck from behind,
we must eliminate any troublesome
military powers in advance.
I see...
Commence the operation.
Rochina, I leave the rest to you!
Sir!

rows.notes: Segs 2-4, 6-7, 10-11, 13, 16: blank headers, read as continuations. Seg 9-10 is one sentence split across pages, kept split. [jp]: [jp] read as 'this universe' (Redros crosses worlds through gates). | [editorial 13] 'So we are not struck' was unclear (reads as 'therefore')

segments.en:
Yo!
Long time no see!

Looking good,
Kanji!

Looks like we're fighting
together again.
Yeah!

I'm counting on you guys!
Good to have you!
The Dragonar Team has joined you.

rows.notes: Seg 4: blank header after Kanji's 'Yeah!', read as Kanji continuing (could also be one of the Dragonar pilots).

segments.en:
Your Excellency!
We've been expecting you.

Mm.
Is the combined fleet
ready?
All preparations are complete.

Use it as you see fit,
Your Excellency.
Well done!

From this moment, our army will
throw its full strength into
pacifying the Earth Sphere.

Joined up with the Redros Army's
Konpei Island Combined Fleet.
